rows.text: calls the site `001C36F0` + 0x2B on each 0x10-byte element from qword `[rcx]` up to (not including) qword `rcx+8`; then, when qword `[rcx]` is non-null, calls slot `+0x18` of the vtable of the object at `rcx+0x18` with that object, qword `[rcx]` and `(qword rcx+0x10 - qword [rcx])` rounded down to a multiple of 0x10; when it is null it returns without that call
when `dl` is non-zero XORs 2 into dword `rcx+0x130`; when `dl` is 0 copies dword `rcx+0x134` into dword `rcx+0x130`

notes: 001C36F0: the size mask is a 64-bit AND that clears the low four bits, stated in words.
